newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg seeks to sweeten cereal sales - paper.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg seeks to sweeten cereal sales - paper.

text.p: Kellogg Co is expected to announce today the first brand extension of its top-selling frosted cereal - Cocoa Frosted Flakes, USA Today said Tuesday.
The report said the new cereal, which will be fat-free and cholesterol-free, should be in stores in late April and will sell for about $2.99 for a 16.1-ounce box.
The move comes after the cereal industry saw domestic revenues from supermarket sales fall six percent to $7.5 billion last year, the paper said.
